additions.reason: Distinguish anonymous discussion evidence from a population survey.
Distinguish biological capability from adult readiness, connecting the source child-marriage project.
Reason about limits of visible evidence and the distinction between kinds of maturity.
Distinguish a biological process from barriers to participation.
Apply nutrient variety to an affordable meal and substitutions.
Accessible participation and proportionate exercise precautions.
Apply the difference between evidence preservation and harmful redistribution.
Concrete refusal and exit example, with no real substances used.

corrections.change: Use adolescent-specific cycle guidance (21–45 days; generally no more than seven days bleeding), not a fixed 28–30-day timetable or adult 21–35-day range.
Explain follicle blockage, oil and inflammation without equating acne with dirty skin. Gentle care; no drug prescribing.
Replace absolute sex-exclusive categories with common/typically more pronounced patterns; voice-box growth occurs in both.
Make the doctor’s assessment explicit: thyroid enlargement is different from normal larynx growth. Appearance alone is insufficient for diagnosis.
Do not equate biodegradable claims with permission to litter, flush or home-compost. Safe local disposal and clean/dry reusable supplies.
Addiction is neither inevitable after one use nor merely a failure of willpower; supportive professional care retained.
Remove instruction not to feel frightened; give actionable support and protect evidence without redistributing harm.
Explicitly distinguish reproductive capability from readiness for marriage and parenthood.
Preserve both source food groups as painted artwork; account for variety/portions and avoid labelling a whole person’s diet from one meal.
Replace source lung colour before/after with a labelled airway cross-section model; no claim that the drawing depicts every affected lung.
